scope: Exact281 accepted Galician/Dutch/German changes and selected independently reviewed consumer dependencies. Complete341P0/P1 rows per language and all precise holds remain in independent review evidence; no whole-language/device/native-human certification.

string/formats22_animation_message.source: This %1$s contains %2$s frames. AN Paint edits still images and does not preserve animation.
string/formats22_animation_message.target: "Este %1$s contén %2$s fotogramas. AN Paint edita imaxes fixas e non conserva a animación."

string/ui_a_separate_recovery_copy_has_b.source: %1$s A separate recovery copy has been kept. Use File > Export recovery copy to save its ZIP. Extract canvas.png from it and load that image to use the normal resize options if needed.

string/ui_no_resize_fits_decoder_memory.source: Even at the smallest output size, this image cannot be loaded for editing within the current memory limits. Cancel and use a smaller source image.

string/ui_d_d_pixels_2f_mp_exceeds_the_c.source: %1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) exceeds the current safe editing budget of %4$.2f MP. AN Paint keeps the complete image in memory and reserves space for transforms and selections. Available memory determines this budget. The operation was stopped before allocating the oversized bitmap. No automatic resizing was applied.
string/ui_d_d_pixels_2f_mp_exceeds_the_c.target: Eine Auflösung von %1$d × %2$d px (%3$.2f MP) überschreitet das aktuelle sichere Bearbeitungslimit von %4$.2f MP. AN Paint hält das vollständige Bild im Speicher und reserviert Platz für Transformationen und Auswahlen. Der verfügbare Speicher bestimmt dieses Limit. Der Vorgang wurde gestoppt, bevor die übergroße Bitmap angelegt wurde. Es wurde keine automatische Größenänderung vorgenommen.
